turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've saved up enough to upgrade one part of my gaming setup, and I keep changing my mind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me walk you through all the options, then you can tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A new graphics card would let me play the latest games on high settings, but it's the priciest.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a really good monitor, bigger and faster, so everything I already play looks smoother.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could also get a proper desk chair, because my back hurts after an evening of playing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And there's a nice wireless headset, which would mean no more tangled cables when I play with friends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The graphics card and the monitor both make games look better, but the monitor helps everything you already own. Honestly though, if your back hurts, the chair might matter most. The headset is a nice to have.
